author: Karl Rock
description:
A taxi driver in Karachi, Pakistan, told me how he took a passenger straight to the police station after she refused to pay her fare!

He says the woman had been drinking and refused to pay. After she got back into his taxi, he decided to drive her directly to Sohrab Goth Police Station. But even the police didn't help him!

Was the taxi driver right or wrong to take matters into his own hands?
title: Taxi Driver Took Her to the Police!
